why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the Black Mirror dashboard Go to the Black Mirror Reputation Dashboard , the page that starts the campaign.
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet Use the Connect Wallet button on the dashboard so your activity is tied to your wallet.
3 Step 3 : Complete the tasks Work through the tasks the dashboard offers to build your reputation score.
4 Step 4 : Check your history Sign in to see the points and rewards history your wallet has earned.
